test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The marks obtained by four students in Mathematics and Hindi are shown in the table below. (The maximum marks for each subject are 100.)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/785933907659b099a6b50596b15414a05347c586703469c4387e2bb6c41d0c02.png] 

What is the product of the average marks obtained by all the four students in Mathematics and those in Hindi?
solution:
**Given:**

Marks of four students (P, Q, R, S) in Mathematics and Hindi.

Student P: Mathematics = 84, Hindi = 88

Student Q: Mathematics = 90, Hindi = 74

Student R: Mathematics = 92, Hindi = 70

Student S: Mathematics = 70, Hindi = 68

Maximum marks for each subject = 100.

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of values / Number of values

Product = Average of Mathematics marks × Average of Hindi marks

**Calculations:**

Sum of marks in Mathematics = Marks of P (Maths) + Marks of Q (Maths) + Marks of R (Maths) + Marks of S (Maths)

⇒ Sum of marks in Mathematics = 84 + 90 + 92 + 70 = 336

⇒ Average marks in Mathematics = 336 / 4 = 84

Sum of marks in Hindi = Marks of P (Hindi) + Marks of Q (Hindi) + Marks of R (Hindi) + Marks of S (Hindi)

⇒ Sum of marks in Hindi = 88 + 74 + 70 + 68 = 300

⇒ Average marks in Hindi = 300 / 4 = 75

⇒ Product = 84 × 75 = 6300

**∴ The correct answer is option 4.**
